Latin Capital Letter A With Grave Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Latin Capital Letter A With Grave is 0192. Hold Alt, type 0192 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Latin Capital Letter A With Grave also has the Unicode codepoint U+00C0, so you can type it with Alt+192 on Windows, search for U+00C0 in macOS's Character Viewer, use À in HTML, or \00C0 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Latin Capital Letter A With Grave character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. HTML also defines the named entity À for Latin Capital Letter A With Grave, but the numeric form À is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type latin capital letter a with grave on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 0 1 9 2 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Latin Capital Letter A With Grave character (À) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type latin capital letter a with grave on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Latin Capital Letter A With Grave. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Latin Capital Letter A With Grave" and click the character to insert it.

How to use latin capital letter a with grave in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\00C0"; ()
  • Python: \u00C0 or chr(0xC0)
  • JavaScript: \u00C0 or String.fromCodePoint(0xC0)
  • JSON: "\u00C0"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Latin Capital Letter A With Grave?

The legacy Alt code for Latin Capital Letter A With Grave is 0192. Hold Alt, type 0 1 9 2 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type À without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as À, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+192 not work?

Alt+192 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Latin Capital Letter A With Grave?

The Unicode codepoint for Latin Capital Letter A With Grave is U+00C0. You can use this value in HTML as À, in CSS as \00C0, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type À on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+00C0, then click it.
